response.sql: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) as baseline FROM rating_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length, b.baseline FROM rating_avgs r, baseline_val b WHERE r.avg_length > b.baseline), mean_above_baseline_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) as mean_above FROM above_baseline), final_ratings AS (SELECT a.rating, a.avg_length, a.baseline, m.mean_above FROM above_baseline a, mean_above_baseline_val m WHERE a.avg_length > m.mean_above) SELECT AVG(f.avg_length) as final_mean, AVG(f.avg_length - f.baseline) as mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(f.avg_length - f.mean_above) as mean_excess_over_intermediate_mean FROM final_ratings f
